plan.text: Win the opening diamond in South, preserving the other diamond honor. Cash CA, CK and CQ. A 3–2 club split supplies ten tricks; against 4–1, return to South with SA and concede a club to establish the ninth trick. Keep the heart winners and remaining diamond stopper available for control and entries; reassess if clubs split 5–0.
